about: Fixed cases for `memcode eval-agent`: each is a condensed log, optionally files and starting memories, and what memcode should keep (expect) or must not (avoid). A pattern matches a kept memory when every word group is in its text (case-insensitive; '|' separates alternatives).

cases.name: profile from code

files.src/OrderState.java: public enum OrderState { NEW, PAID, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED }

log: [user] the refund flow double-charges sometimes, can you look at PaymentGateway?

[read] src/PaymentGateway.java | import com.stripe.Stripe; import com.stripe.model.Refund; public class PaymentGateway { /** Wraps the Stripe SDK for charges and refunds. Used by OrderService only. */ public Charge charge(Order o) { ... } public Refund refund(Order o) { ... } }

[read] src/OrderService.java | public class OrderService { /** Entry point of the order lifecycle: place, pay, ship, cancel. */ private final PaymentGateway gateway; public void pay(Order o) { gateway.charge(o); o.setState(OrderState.PAID); } }
[read] src/OrderState.java | public enum OrderState { NEW, PAID, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED }
[ran] `./mvnw -q -pl orders test` -> ok | Tests run: 48, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
[agent] The double charge comes from retrying charge() after a timeout; I made refund idempotent with a key.

expect.name: the Stripe SDK and its wrapper

avoid.name: the fix itself as a memory

cases.name: deploy, infra, branching
log: [user] The checkout latency spiked again, see https://grafana.acme.dev/d/checkout-p95, can you check orders.py?
[ran] `pytest -q` -> failed | ERROR: file or directory not found: tests
[ran] `pytest -q checks/` -> ok | 42 passed in 3.1s
[read] docs/RUNBOOK.md | # Runbook  On-call steps for checkout incidents; rollback with `helm rollback shop`.
[user] Put the fix on a feature branch off develop, we never branch off main. main only gets release merges.
[read] deploy/helm/values-prod.yaml | replicaCount: 3  image: 123456.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/shop  postgres: rds-prod.eu-west-1
[ran] `cat .github/workflows/deploy.yml` -> ok | on: push: tags: ['v*']  jobs: deploy-staging: ...  deploy-prod: needs: approval  run: helm upgrade shop deploy/helm -f deploy/helm/values-prod.yaml
[agent] Releases are tagged v*, deploy.yml deploys staging and then prod after approval, on EKS in eu-west-1.

cases.name: a correction
log: [user] add a test for the new parser
[wrote] tests/test_parser.py | def test_parse(): assert parse('a') == ['a']
[user] No - in this repo tests go in checks/, never tests/. Move it.
[ran] `git mv tests/test_parser.py checks/test_parser.py` -> ok |
[agent] Moved the test to checks/test_parser.py.

expect.name: tests go in checks/, from the user

cases.name: a decision, not the agent's progress

[ran] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` -> ok | Ran 32 tests in 0.8s OK
[ran] `git push -u origin feat/review` -> ok | branch feat/review set up to track origin

cases.name: a request for now is not a rule
log: [user] for this change only, skip the linter, we are in a hurry
[ran] `git commit -m 'fix typo'` -> ok | 1 file changed
[agent] Committed without running the linter, as asked.

avoid.name: skipping the linter as a standing rule

cases.name: a stale memory to revive

memories.text: orders.total(items) sums the item prices; callers pass a list of Item.
memories.original:
def total(items):
    return sum(i.price for i in items)

log: [user] add tax to the order total, callers now pass a tax rate
[edited] orders.py | def total(items, tax_rate):     """Sum of item prices including tax."""     return sum(i.price for i in items) * (1 + tax_rate)
[agent] Done: total now takes tax_rate and applies it.

expect.name: the stale memory updated to tax_rate and revived
